The '''Zhdant''' system lies within hex 2719 of [[Gaval Subsector]], within [[Zhdant Sector]]. 
* [[Zhdant (world)|Zhdant]], the [[mainworld]] of the system, is the [[homeworld]] of the [[Zhodani]].

== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
The system is centered on the star ''[[Pliebr (star)|Pliebr]]''.
* It is a yellow-orange main sequence.

=== System Data ===
The [[Zhdant (system)|worlds of the system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
#'''[[Adrablsish (world)|Adrablsish]]''': Innermost "hot-rockball" planet tidally locked to [[Pliebr (star)|Pliebr]]. Robot mining is carried out here.
#'''Pliantshotl''': Second planet. Bare rock previously used as [[Zhodani]] Hostile environment training area
#'''[[Zhdant (world)|Zhdant]]''': [[Zhodani]] Home world.  '''[[Zhdant (world)|Zhdant]]''' is 9620 km in diameter, and orbits [[Pliebr (star)|Pliebr ]] at a distance of 0.769<small>AU</small>, completing one orbit every 275.2 standard days.  It rotates once on its axis every 27.02 standard days.  
::* A single large tidally-locked reddish-pink moon named '''[[Viepchakl (world)|Viepchakl]]''' which possesses a very thin atmosphere orbits '''[[Zhdant (world)|Zhdant]]'''.  '''[[Viepchakl (world)|Viepchakl]]''' orbits '''[[Zhdant (world)|Zhdant]]''' once every 40.7 local days at a distance of 379,500 km.  
#'''Dlemstiats Tsiaqr''': Asteroid Belt. Still major mining source.
#'''[[Brovlekal (world)|Brovlekal]]''': Only gas giant. This planet has three large satellites and six small ones.  The satellites are home to traffic-control installations and large naval system-defense bases. 
#'''Emkachdraf''': Small airless iceball. There is a minor robotic system defense base located on the surface.

== History & Background (Dossier) ==
The system is bustling. There is a considerable amount of in-system activity.
* There are multiple orbital and surface facilities.
* Commercial vessels arrive and depart constantly
* Commo is buzzing with chatter and signals. Communications are in [[Zdetl]].
* Multiple navigation beacons are active.
* Vessels regularly travel among the other worlds and moons that make up the system.
* Naval vessels are active in the system.

==== System Timeline ====
* [[300]]-[[420]]: the [[First Survey]] charts the system.
* [[995]]-[[1065]]: the [[Second Survey]] charts the system.
* [[1065]]: the [[Second Survey]] is published.
